concerns.text: Task T006 consumes `data/processed/entropy_scores.csv` but no prior task in the plan produces this file. T004’s description only mentions generating correlation results and a plot; it does not create `entropy_scores.csv`. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule and leaves a missing artifact.

Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) yet it creates the project skeleton and directory hierarchy that downstream tasks (e.g., T002, T003) rely on. Running T001 in parallel with any consumer could cause race conditions or missing paths, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T003 is also marked `[P]` but it writes core Python modules (`loader.py`, `activation_capture.py`, etc.) that are imported by many later tasks (T004‑T010). Parallel execution before the modules exist would raise import errors, making the `[P]` designation inaccurate.
